_comment: VMM mem_guardian overrides. This 7 GB box has no headroom, and offline analysis jobs (a colleague running vmm-analysis, plus pcapng-parsing work) have twice driven MemAvailable under 900 MB. The guardian PROTECTS the flask from itself but the kernel OOM killer does not, so with nothing killable the kernel took the DAQ flask instead - three times on 2026-07-31. Everything under the offline analysis directories is therefore killable; the DAQ services stay covered by the built-in protect list (vmm_daq_control.py, daq_control.py, hv_control.py, lv_control.py, qa_watcher.py, dumpcap, Server.py, start_flask, flask, mem_guardian.py). Killing an analysis job costs a rerun; losing the flask costs beam.
